name: Restaurant portion cost builder
why: Costs one batch of one dish from real weights and prices, the same method as the recipe costing skill.

name: Prepare a restaurant shift handover
why: A handover with food safety issues first and an open-issue list, which feeds the shift log and weekly review.

name: Restaurant shift exception review assistant
why: Turns end-of-shift notes into an open-issue register and escalations for the next lead.

name: Check a catering order before service
why: Checks a catering order against the quote and event details, with a service checklist, for caterers and event nights.

name: Cost every step and turn your waste into profit
why: Puts a price on each kind of waste, a useful next step after the waste log in the weekly review.

name: Check supplier invoices before approval
why: Matches invoices before the owner pays them, which keeps the prices on recipe cards honest.

name: Compare supplier prices on the same basis
why: Compares quotes on the same units and terms before a stock order or a supplier change is put to the owner.

name: Prepare a goods receipt discrepancy brief
why: Matches orders, delivery notes and invoices line by line, a common cause of food cost gaps.

name: Discount and price change checker
why: Checks how deep a promotion or price change can go before it eats the dish's margin.

name: Public review reply desk
why: Checked replies for each batch of reviews, with risky ones held for the owner, as in the review reply prompt.

name: Repeatable standards sheet writer
why: A one-page sheet of checkable standards, the backbone of station guides and plating standards.

name: Second location readiness checker
why: Checks whether the first site runs without the owner before a second restaurant opens.
